name: Veronika Cifrová Ostrihoňová - Après le considérant E - Am 5
title: REPORT on public access to documents – report covering the years 2022 - 2024
part_text: Ed. Whereas the Commission has been evading responsibility for years and has failed to properly handle public access to documents; whereas the subsidies granted to NGOs are essentially non-transparent, even though this concerns EU taxpayers’ money; whereas the scandals of recent years have shown that the EU, including Parliament, has been funding NGOs for political lobbying;
